main: Create a production-ready original illustrated Memory Match card-face atlas for Theme Park Shark's mobile GPS theme park game. Reference image 1 is STYLE AND EXACT GRID/FRAME GEOMETRY reference only. Match its polished friendly 2D game art, thick navy outlines, vivid cyan-blue card fields, navy circular central medallions, golden sculpted bevel rims, coral corners, warm glossy highlights. Make a NEW magical keepsakes deck. Landscape 1536 x 1024, EXACT four equal columns by two equal rows; every portrait card 384 x 512; all frames identical positions, no gaps, no outside margins. Keep symbols inside their medallions with large readable silhouettes for tiny phone cards. Top row left to right: sparkling wooden wand with violet star tip; open enchanted purple spellbook with gold clasp; charming snowy-white owl with gold eyes; ornate single golden key. Bottom row left to right: glowing teal hanging lantern; rounded coral potion bottle with cork; violet arched portal with golden star trim; single elegant turquoise feather quill. EXACT 8 DIFFERENT symbols, each one centered and distinct. Magical cozy adventure, premium club-penguin-like tactile illustration in the supplied TPS style, tasteful gold sparkle accents. No labels, no text, no logos, no watermarks, no franchise characters. Do not include space motifs from the style reference. Flat atlas viewed head-on, no perspective, precisely aligned repeating frames, opaque background.
extras: Create a NEW production-ready original illustrated Memory Match card-face extra atlas for Theme Park Shark's mobile GPS game. Supplied reference is the already-approved magical eight-card deck. MATCH its exact blue-gold-coral frame geometry, friendly 2D premium tactile game-art rendering, navy medallions, thick clean navy outlines, warm glossy highlights. This new sheet must be exactly TWO equal portrait cards SIDE BY SIDE, one row, 768 x 512 or proportional 3:2 landscape. Each portrait card matches one 384 x 512 reference cell; no gaps or outside margins. LEFT symbol: a polished violet crystal ball on a small golden stand, with a pale teal magical star suspended inside. RIGHT symbol: an original deep violet pointed wizard hat with a warm gold star buckle and folded brim. Large distinct readable silhouettes centered inside navy medallions. Precisely repeated cyan field, gold rim, coral corners identical reference. No owl/book/wand/key/lantern/potion/portal/quill repeats. No text, labels, logos, watermark, franchise likeness. Head-on flat atlas, opaque background.
